# jamfplatform_pro_macos_onboarding (Data Source)

Reads the current Jamf Pro macOS Onboarding configuration (Settings > Self Service > macOS Onboarding). Singleton — one record per tenant. Items are returned in priority order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the current macOS Onboarding configuration. Items are returned in priority order.
data "jamfplatform_pro_macos_onboarding" "current" {}

output "onboarding_enabled" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_macos_onboarding.current.enabled
}

output "onboarding_item_names" {
  value = [for item in data.jamfplatform_pro_macos_onboarding.current.onboarding_items : item.entity_name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether macOS Onboarding is enabled for the tenant.
- `id` (String) Fixed singleton identifier. Always `singleton`.
- `onboarding_items` (Attributes List) Ordered list of Self Service items presented during macOS onboarding, in priority order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--onboarding_items))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--onboarding_items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `onboarding_items`

Read-Only:

- `entity_id` (String) ID of the referenced Jamf Pro object.
- `entity_name` (String) Display name of the referenced object.
- `id` (String) Identifier for this onboarding item. Returned by Jamf Pro; not user-settable.
- `priority` (Number) Presentation order (1-based).
- `scope_description` (String) Scope summary of the referenced object (the "Scope" column in the admin UI).
- `self_service_entity_type` (String) Type of the referenced object (`OS_X_POLICY`, `OS_X_CONFIG_PROFILE`, `OS_X_MAC_APP`, `OS_X_APP_INSTALLER`).
- `site_description` (String) Site summary of the referenced object (the "Site" column in the admin UI).
